summary: Australia NSW (Crimes Act 1900 s. 192E, common law): fraud carries a single 10-year indictable max regardless of amount (2 years if dealt with summarily as a Table 1 offence), with the amount acting only as a sentencing factor rather than a statutory value tier.
source_citation: Australia NSW Crimes Act 1900 s. 192E (fraud), AustLII; NSW Sentencing Council fraud review — https://www5.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/nsw/consol_act/ca190082/s192e.html
label_raw: s. 192E fraud; indictable max 10 yrs, summary 2 yrs; no value band
harm_duration: up to 10 years (indictable); up to 2 years (summary)

summary: Australia NSW (Crimes Act 1900 s. 117, common law): larceny has a 5-year indictable max, but on summary disposal the custody cap is 2 years while fines scale by value (up to AUD 2,200 for <AUD 2,000 ≈ USD 1,320; up to AUD 5,500 for AUD 2,000–5,000; up to AUD 11,000 above AUD 5,000 ≈ USD 3,300).
source_citation: Australia NSW Crimes Act 1900 s. 117 (larceny), AustLII; Sydney Criminal Lawyers — https://www5.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/nsw/consol_act/ca190082/s117.html
label_raw: s. 117 larceny; summary max 2 yrs, indictable 5 yrs; value-graded fines
harm_duration: up to 2 years (summary); up to 5 years (indictable)

summary: Canada (Criminal Code s. 380, common law): fraud up to CAD 5,000 (~USD 3,650 in 2024) is hybrid with a 2-year max, fraud over CAD 5,000 is indictable with a 14-year max, and total value over CAD 1,000,000 (~USD 730,000) carries a mandatory minimum of 2 years custody on indictment.
source_citation: Canada Criminal Code s. 380 (fraud; CAD 1M minimum added 2011), Justice Canada — https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/c-46/section-380.html
label_raw: s. 380 fraud; >CAD 5,000 max 14 yrs, >CAD 1M min 2 yrs
harm_duration: min 2 years to max 14 years (>CAD 1,000,000); up to 14 years (>CAD 5,000); up to 2 years (≤CAD 5,000)

summary: Canada (Criminal Code s. 322/334, common law): theft up to CAD 5,000 (~USD 3,650 in 2024) is hybrid with a max of 2 years (summary) or 5 years (indictable), while theft over CAD 5,000 is indictable with a max of 10 years.
source_citation: Canada Criminal Code s. 334 (theft), Justice Canada; Criminal Law Notebook — https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/c-46/section-334.html
label_raw: s. 334 theft; ≤CAD 5,000 max 5 yrs, >CAD 5,000 max 10 yrs
harm_duration: up to 5 years (≤CAD 5,000 indictable); up to 10 years (>CAD 5,000)

summary: China (Criminal Law art. 266 + 2011 interpretation, socialist civil law): fraud of an 'especially huge' amount, CNY ≥500,000 (~USD ≥69,500 in 2024), carries 10 years to life imprisonment.
source_citation: PRC Criminal Law art. 266 (en.spp.gov.cn) + 2011 SPC/SPP fraud interpretation thresholds (chinalawtranslate.com) — https://en.spp.gov.cn/2020-12/26/c_948417_10.htm

summary: China (Criminal Law art. 266 + 2011 interpretation, socialist civil law): fraud of a 'huge' amount, CNY 30,000–100,000 (~USD 4,170–13,900 in 2024), carries 3–10 years imprisonment.
source_citation: PRC Criminal Law art. 266 (en.spp.gov.cn) + 2011 SPC/SPP fraud interpretation thresholds (chinalawtranslate.com) — https://en.spp.gov.cn/2020-12/26/c_948417_10.htm

summary: China (Criminal Law art. 266 + 2011 SPC/SPP interpretation, socialist civil law): fraud of a 'relatively large' amount, CNY 3,000–10,000 (~USD 417–1,390 in 2024), carries up to 3 years imprisonment.
source_citation: PRC Criminal Law art. 266 (en.spp.gov.cn) + 2011 SPC/SPP fraud interpretation thresholds (chinalawtranslate.com) — https://en.spp.gov.cn/2020-12/26/c_948417_10.htm

summary: China (Criminal Law art. 264 + theft interpretation, socialist civil law): theft of an 'especially huge' amount, CNY 300,000–500,000 (~USD 41,700–69,500 in 2024), carries 10 years to life imprisonment.
source_citation: PRC Criminal Law art. 264 + SPC/SPP Interpretation on Handling Cases of Theft (chinalawtranslate.com) — https://www.chinalawtranslate.com/en/SPC,-SPP-Interpretation-on-the-Applicable-Law-in-Handling-Cases-of-Theft/

summary: China (Criminal Law art. 264 + theft interpretation, socialist civil law): theft of a 'huge' amount, CNY 30,000–100,000 (~USD 4,170–13,900 in 2024), carries 3–10 years imprisonment.
source_citation: PRC Criminal Law art. 264 + SPC/SPP Interpretation on Handling Cases of Theft (chinalawtranslate.com) — https://www.chinalawtranslate.com/en/SPC,-SPP-Interpretation-on-the-Applicable-Law-in-Handling-Cases-of-Theft/

summary: China (Criminal Law art. 264 + SPC/SPP theft interpretation, socialist civil law): theft of a 'relatively large' amount, CNY 1,000–3,000 (~USD 139–417 in 2024), carries up to 3 years detention/surveillance.
source_citation: PRC Criminal Law art. 264 + SPC/SPP Interpretation on Handling Cases of Theft (chinalawtranslate.com) — https://www.chinalawtranslate.com/en/SPC,-SPP-Interpretation-on-the-Applicable-Law-in-Handling-Cases-of-Theft/

summary: France (Code pénal art. 313-1/313-2, civil law): base fraud of any amount is 5 years plus EUR 375,000 fine, rising by circumstance (not loss amount) to 7 years / EUR 750,000 (~USD 810,000) when aggravated and to 10 years / EUR 1,000,000 (~USD 1.08M) for organized-gang fraud.
label_raw: Code pénal art. 313-1/313-2 fraud; 5/7/10 yrs by circumstance

summary: France (Code pénal art. 311-3 et seq., civil law): simple theft of any amount is 3 years plus EUR 45,000 fine, with aggravating circumstances (manner/victim, not value band) scaling up to 5, 7, or 10 years.
source_citation: France Code pénal art. 311-3 et seq. (vol), Légifrance — https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/section_lc/LEGITEXT000006070719/LEGISCTA000006149835/
label_raw: Code pénal art. 311-3 theft; base 3 yrs, aggravated up to 10 yrs

summary: Germany (StGB §263, civil law): base fraud of any amount carries up to 5 years or a fine, but a 'particularly serious case' for large-scale loss is triggered by case law (BGHSt 48, 360, 2003) at a realized loss of EUR 50,000 (~USD 54,000 in 2024), raising the range to 6 months–10 years.
source_citation: Germany StGB §263(3) sentence 2 no.2 'Vermögensverlust großen Ausmaßes'; threshold per BGH BGHSt 48, 360 (7 Oct 2003) via rfp-rechtsanwaelte.de and strafrecht-online.org — https://rfp-rechtsanwaelte.de/vermoegensverlust-grossen-ausmasses/
label_raw: StGB §263 fraud; EUR 50,000 enhancement to 6 mo–10 yrs
harm_duration: 6 months to 10 years (above EUR 50,000 loss); up to 5 years (base)

summary: Germany (StGB §242/§243, civil law): basic theft of any amount carries up to 5 years custody or a fine, with a 'particularly serious case' (§243, e.g. organized/commercial) raising the range to 3 months–10 years, with no statutory value band on the base offence.
source_citation: Germany StGB §242/§243 (theft / particularly serious case), gesetze-im-internet.de English StGB; se-legal.de summary — https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/englisch_stgb/englisch_stgb.html
label_raw: StGB §242/§243 theft; base up to 5 yrs, aggravated 3 mo–10 yrs
harm_duration: 3 months to 10 years (aggravated); up to 5 years (base)

summary: Japan (Penal Code art. 246 / 246-2, civil law): fraud and computer fraud of any amount carry up to 10 years imprisonment with no fine option and no statutory value tier, with the amount affecting the sentence only as a discretionary factor.
source_citation: Japan Penal Code arts. 246/246-2 (fraud), Act 45 of 1907 as amended, Japanese Law Translation — https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/3581/en
label_raw: Penal Code art. 246/246-2 fraud; up to 10 yrs; no fine, no value band

summary: Japan (Penal Code art. 235, civil law): theft of any amount carries up to 10 years imprisonment or a fine up to JPY 500,000 (~USD 3,300 in 2024), with no statutory value band and amount weighed only as a judicial aggravating factor (habitual theft up to 20 years).
source_citation: Japan Penal Code art. 235 (theft), Act 45 of 1907 as amended, Japanese Law Translation; courts.go.jp Outline of Criminal Justice 2023 — https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/3581/en
label_raw: Penal Code art. 235 theft; up to 10 yrs or JPY 500,000 fine; no value band
harm_duration: up to 10 years (up to 20 years habitual)
